content: MDN documents localStorage as origin-scoped and persistent across normal sessions, but access can throw SecurityError when persistence is blocked, writes can throw QuotaExceededError, private-mode data is cleared at session end, and file URL behavior is undefined. Feature detection requires a test write. For two numeric records, use a versioned validated payload, wrap reads/parsing/writes, recover from malformed values, and treat persistence as optional rather than blocking play.
